Name: Where-Winds-Meet-food
Author: Yvbie
Description:
———1.01———
这个模组不会取代任何原版生物——骆驼和玉杯鸟都是全新的。
它是根据玩星露谷物语的白叶朋友的要求创建的，这激励我学习模组。
所有精灵都是我绘制的（尽管它们可能需要改进），并且可能存在错误 - 我会不断更新模组。
宠物玉杯鸟可以从玛妮那里领养。Pierre's、Gus' 和 Willy's 商店出售
27 种食谱。
农作物种子可在 Pierre's 购买。这两种骆驼类型
需要谷仓，由玛妮出售。
注意：玉杯鸟在接近时可能会开始跳跃（可能是因为我使用了小狗动画框架），但符合原著了。

This mod does not replace any vanilla creatures—both the camels and Jade Cup Bird are completely new additions.
It was created at the request of my friend Bai Ye, a fellow Stardew Valley player, whose enthusiasm inspired me to learn modding. All sprites were hand-drawn by me (though they may need further refinement), and there may be some bugs—I will continue updating the mod.
The pet Jade Cup Bird can be adopted from Marnie. A total of 27 new recipes are available for purchase at Pierre's General Store, Gus' Saloon, and Willy's Fish Shop. Crop seeds can be bought from Pierre. Both camel varieties require a Barn and are sold by Marnie.
Note: The Jade Cup Bird may start jumping when approached (likely because I used the puppy animation framework), but this unexpectedly fits perfectly with its original lore!

———1.03————
新增7道菜品（来自燕云新版本的家业系统，燕云有好多菜居然是套用了其他菜的模型，菜谱在格斯，沙漠商店，威利和旅行商人那里购买）
新增了3种作物（东陵瓜，寒瓜，大豆）
新增了一种果树（梨树，开梨花）
修复鱼类图鉴不显示的问题，修复部分文本错误问题，将鯚鱼改为鳜鱼（鯚不能显示）

New Additions:
Added 7 new dishes (From the new Homestead system in the Where-Winds-Meet update - turns out Yan Yun reused existing food models for many of these dishes!
Recipes can be purchased from：Saloon，Sandy，FishShop，Traveler)
Added 3 new crops:
Winter Ridge Melon (东陵瓜)
watermelon (寒瓜)
Soybeans (大豆)
Added 1 new fruit tree: Pear Tree (blooms with white pear blossoms in spring)
Bug Fixes:
Fixed an issue where fish encyclopedia entries failed to display
Corrected text errors in various descriptions
Renamed "鯚鱼" (jì yú) to "鳜鱼" (guì yú, mandarin fish) – (original character "鯚" was unsupported in the game font)

Downloads.Description:
修复了双瓜芙蓉需要物品显示错误的bug
Fixed a bug where the Twin Melon Hibiscus displayed incorrect required items.
